text:
Alex Chen: quick handoff — I'm wrapping my shift. Titanium staged launch tomorrow 2026-06-02 14:00 UTC. They expect a burst ~120 rps for ~10m during promo. Primary risk: model variant change and autoscaler tuning. Runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/titanium-launch

Mei Patel: acked. I'm taking oncall. any hotspots I should watch first 30m?

Alex Chen: thanks. Top 3: 1) autoscaler thresholds (we set min=2,max=40,scale_step=4), 2) prefix cache warmup for heavy prompt templates, 3) quantized model variant increased tokenization CPU on LB nodes. If autoscaler stalls, fallback to model nvw-3b-fp16.

DeployBot: Deployment completed to prod-titanium @ 2026-05-30T22:14Z — image: rwinf/titanium:v2.3 — rolling 12/12 nodes.

Mei Patel: what's the live routing policy during the spike? region/latency/cost?

Alex Chen: routing = region -> latency -> cost. For Titanium we've pinned region eu-west-1 for data residency; if eu-West capacity hits >85% we overflow to eu-central with canary weights 10% then 30%. Manual override is in console under "Routing -> prod-titanium".

Jordan Reyes: SLA question from CS: Contract says p99 < 300ms for inference. Given quantized model, is that realistic?

Priya Narang: CS fyi — Titanium negotiated 99.9% uptime and p99 target. We have a mitigation plan (A/B fallback) if p99 drifts beyond threshold during promo. Notify me immediately if p99 > 400ms for 5m.

Alex Chen: noted. Realistically p99 may spike to ~450ms during warmup with q4 quant. If that happens, set routing override to fp16 variant (nvw-7b-fp16) and enable extra pool from Dedicated reserve (pager: page SRE team).

Mei Patel: got it. How do I trigger the dedicated pool? any CLI?

Alex Chen: yes — quick CLI:
```
rwctl capacity allocate --pool dedicated-titanium --count 4 --reason "promo surge"
```
Then toggle routing fallback: Console -> Model configs -> set primary -> nvw-7b-fp16.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall shift change recorded. Mei Patel is oncall from 2026-06-02 13:50 UTC to 2026-06-02 20:00 UTC.

Mei Patel: I'll watch autoscaler, p99 dashboard, and token service (kv cache). please tag me on PagerDuty if any capacity alerts fire.

Jordan Reyes: tagging ops runbook snippet for quick checks:
- check `pool_utilization` > 0.85? escalate
- check `kv_cache_hit_rate` < 0.6? warm cache by replay job
- check `error_rate` increase > 2x basal? rollback

Priya Narang: I'll standby for CS comms and pre-draft an incident message template in case we need to notify Titanium. Keep me looped.

Alex Chen: one more: small known issue — tokenization mismatch with the new tokenizer_polyfill on 2 nodes. If you see `tokenizeError` in logs, cordon the node and trigger `rebuild-token-cache` job (link in runbook).

Mei Patel: I see. I'll add that to watchlist and ping if I see `tokenizeError`. Taking point now — Alex enjoy your break :party_parrot: 

Alex Chen: thanks, appreciate it. Leaving notes in the runbook update now. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: Canary metrics summary (last 15m): request rate 18 rps -> 122 rps, p95 210ms, p99 360ms, error 0.4%.

Mei Patel: good to know. starting active watch at 13:30 UTC. If nothing odd, I'll close the watch after +45m post-launch.

Jordan Reyes: thx all. I'll standby for rollback decision if p99 stays > 400ms for 10m.

Priya Narang: copied. I'll prepare the customer-facing note template now.
